description: This file defines models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing historical equity data from the Alpha Vantage API, including data transformation and handling of different intervals and adjustments.

classes.name: AVEquityHistoricalQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching historical equity data from Alpha Vantage, including interval, adjustment, and extended hours options.

classes.name: AVEquityHistoricalData
classes.description: Represents the structure of historical equity data, including adjusted close, dividend, and split ratio.

classes.name: AVEquityHistoricalFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching, transformation, and processing from Alpha Vantage API, supporting different intervals and adjustments.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters by setting default start and end dates if not provided.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from Alpha Vantage API, processes CSV responses, and handles intraday and historical data.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw fetched data into standardized AVEquityHistoricalData objects, filtering by date range.
